en.headline: Observatory raises yellow fire danger warning at 6am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the yellow fire danger warning at 6:00 a.m., indicating a high fire risk, and reminded the public to take extra precautions.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 6:00 a.m. on Sunday, stating that the fire risk is high.
The Observatory said the warning indicates a rather high fire danger and called on the public to be extra alert and ensure necessary fire precautions are taken.
At 6 a.m. the air temperature at the Observatory was 27 degrees Celsius with relative humidity at 77 per cent. The warning remains in force until further notice.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨6時發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，提醒市民特別提高警覺並採取適當防火措施。
body: 天文台周日上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，指火災危險性頗高。
天文台表示，黃色警告意味火災危險性頗高，市民應特別提高警覺，並確保採取適當防火措施。
截至上午6時，天文台錄得氣溫27度，相對濕度77%。警告將維持至另行通知。
